clauses.text:
SCHEDULE
By virtue of the authority vested in me by section 5317 of title 5  
of the United States Code, as amended, Executive Order No. 11248 ^of  
October 10,1965, as amended, is further amended as follows:

1. Section 1 of that Order, placing certain positions in level IV  of  
the Federal Executive Salary Schedule, is amended by deleting “(9)  
Executive Director,* Cabinet Committee on Price Stability”, and in­
serting in lieu thereof “ (9) Deputy Under Secretary for International  
Labor Affairs, Department of Labor”.

2. Section 2 of that Order, placing certain positions in level V of the  
Federal Executive Salary Schedule, is amended by adding thereto the  
following:

(23) Deputy Assistant Postmaster General, Bureau of Operations,  
Post Office Department.

(24) Director, Office of Minority Business Enterprise, Department  
of Commerce.

AMENDING EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 11248, PLACING CERTAIN POSI­

SCHEDULE
By virtue of the authority vested in me by section 5317 of title 5  
of the United States Code, as amended, Executive Order No. 11248 ^of  
October 10,1965, as amended, is further amended as follows:
1. Section 1 of that Order, placing certain positions in level IV  of  
the Federal Executive Salary Schedule, is amended by deleting “(9)  
Executive Director,* Cabinet Committee on Price Stability”, and in­
serting in lieu thereof “ (9) Deputy Under Secretary for International  
Labor Affairs, Department of Labor”.
2. Section 2 of that Order, placing certain positions in level V of the  
Federal Executive Salary Schedule, is amended by adding thereto the  
following:
(23) Deputy Assistant Postmaster General, Bureau of Operations,  
Post Office Department.
(24) Director, Office of Minority Business Enterprise, Department  
of Commerce.
T h e W h it e H ouse ,
May 10,1969.
[F.R. Doc. 69-5781; Filed, May 12, 1969; 1: 22 p.m.]

reported_material_gaps: Clause EO:11468#item2-level-V-item23: the effective date on which Pub. L. 91-375 (Postal Reorganization Act) ended the Post Office Department position of Deputy Assistant Postmaster General, Bureau of Operations, is not in held sources. The clause ended then or, at the latest, on 1971-12-06 (EO 11634 item 2(a)). Needs the statute's commencement provisions and the Postal Service commencement date.
versions.research_rationale: EO 11468 (1) replaces level IV item (9), the Executive Director of the Cabinet Committee on Price Stability, with the Deputy Under Secretary for International Labor Affairs, and (2) adds level V items (23) Deputy Assistant Postmaster General, Bureau of Operations and (24) Director, Office of Minority Business Enterprise. Item (9) was renumbered (8) by EO 11581 and ended with EO 11708 sec. 3 on March 23, 1973; EO 11708 sec. 1(12) places the same position anew. Item (24) was replaced by EO 11516 on March 19, 1970. Item (23) was renumbered and then formally deleted by EO 11634 on December 6, 1971. Before that, however, the Postal Reorganization Act (Pub. L. 91-375) abolished the Post Office Department, whose positions the 5 U.S.C. 5315 notes show it struck. That earlier statutory end is probable but not dated in held sources, so that clause's first_end stays open. The whole-order end is 1973-03-23 in any case. Family method: the researcher read the saved official Federal Register OCR text layers (heading to FR Doc line) of this order, of EO 11248 and of all 40 orders that the OFR disposition notes and the 1989 Codification list as amending it, plus EO 11708, 11715, 11736 and 11768, and traced every item of EO 11248 sections 1 and 2 through each addition, deletion, word substitution and renumbering. EO 11708 sec. 3 (signed and filed March 23, 1973; no other effective date) revokes EO 11248 as amended, except for the eight positions listed in its section 2; none of them is a position whose placement this order's text still supplied. Where a later amender deletes an item and inserts another in its place, the earlier item's placement ends on that amender's effective date; the series' separate 'substituting for the words' formula is treated as a retitling that continues the item. Pure deletions, renumberings and effective-date provisions are one-time edits completed when the order took effect. The 5 U.S.C. 5315-5316 amendment notes for 1964-1973 record no statutory placement of the positions concerned. Abolition of a position by unpublished departmental action is outside the held sources and is a limitation of this bounded search. Page images were not viewed; quotations are exact from the saved OCR, including its recognition errors. No human certification is asserted.

savings_residuals.reason: The order only placed, removed or renumbered positions in pay levels IV and V of the Executive Schedule under 5 U.S.C. 5317 (formerly sec. 303(f) of the 1964 Salary Reform Act). Removal of a placement operates prospectively; pay already received is a completed historical consequence, and no entitlement, transfer of functions or right is preserved. Neither the acting order nor EO 11708 contains a savings or incumbent-protection clause for this order's items. The only carve-out, EO 11708 sec. 3's exception for the positions listed in its sec. 2, does not cover them; EO 11768's incumbent clause (1974) concerns its own list.

savings_residuals.reason: The order only placed, removed or renumbered positions in pay levels IV and V of the Executive Schedule under 5 U.S.C. 5317 (formerly sec. 303(f) of the 1964 Salary Reform Act). Removal of a placement operates prospectively; pay already received is a completed historical consequence, and no entitlement, transfer of functions or right is preserved. Neither the acting order nor EO 11708 contains a savings or incumbent-protection clause for this order's items. The only carve-out, EO 11708 sec. 3's exception for the positions listed in its sec. 2, does not cover them; EO 11768's incumbent clause (1974) concerns its own list.

unresolved_material_gaps: Clause EO:11468#item2-level-V-item23: the effective date on which Pub. L. 91-375 (Postal Reorganization Act) ended the Post Office Department position of Deputy Assistant Postmaster General, Bureau of Operations, is not in held sources. The clause ended then or, at the latest, on 1971-12-06 (EO 11634 item 2(a)). Needs the statute's commencement provisions and the Postal Service commencement date.
claim.research_rationale: EO 11468 (1) replaces level IV item (9), the Executive Director of the Cabinet Committee on Price Stability, with the Deputy Under Secretary for International Labor Affairs, and (2) adds level V items (23) Deputy Assistant Postmaster General, Bureau of Operations and (24) Director, Office of Minority Business Enterprise. Item (9) was renumbered (8) by EO 11581 and ended with EO 11708 sec. 3 on March 23, 1973; EO 11708 sec. 1(12) places the same position anew. Item (24) was replaced by EO 11516 on March 19, 1970. Item (23) was renumbered and then formally deleted by EO 11634 on December 6, 1971. Before that, however, the Postal Reorganization Act (Pub. L. 91-375) abolished the Post Office Department, whose positions the 5 U.S.C. 5315 notes show it struck. That earlier statutory end is probable but not dated in held sources, so that clause's first_end stays open. The whole-order end is 1973-03-23 in any case. Family method: the researcher read the saved official Federal Register OCR text layers (heading to FR Doc line) of this order, of EO 11248 and of all 40 orders that the OFR disposition notes and the 1989 Codification list as amending it, plus EO 11708, 11715, 11736 and 11768, and traced every item of EO 11248 sections 1 and 2 through each addition, deletion, word substitution and renumbering. EO 11708 sec. 3 (signed and filed March 23, 1973; no other effective date) revokes EO 11248 as amended, except for the eight positions listed in its section 2; none of them is a position whose placement this order's text still supplied. Where a later amender deletes an item and inserts another in its place, the earlier item's placement ends on that amender's effective date; the series' separate 'substituting for the words' formula is treated as a retitling that continues the item. Pure deletions, renumberings and effective-date provisions are one-time edits completed when the order took effect. The 5 U.S.C. 5315-5316 amendment notes for 1964-1973 record no statutory placement of the positions concerned. Abolition of a position by unpublished departmental action is outside the held sources and is a limitation of this bounded search. Page images were not viewed; quotations are exact from the saved OCR, including its recognition errors. No human certification is asserted.
